objectives.objective_description: Review the Essay Instructions and make sure your Body Paragraphs #1 and #2 (Paragraphs 2 and 3) are in the correct sections of your document. GradeFlow will check both for required structure and how well you explain the evidence you've chosen. Your goal in this task is to make your analysis stronger by using precise, thoughtful language to explain how your quotes support your point. Each body paragraph should do more than list quotes—it should show deep understanding of the play and connect those quotes to the larger ideas you’re writing about. To succeed on this task: Refer to specific events, characters, and conflicts from Romeo and Juliet—not just general ideas. Avoid summary. Instead, explain why the quote matters and what it shows about the consequences of the characters’ actions. Use language that shows insight into the themes, emotions, and outcomes of the play. Choose verbs and vocabulary that clearly show how your evidence relates to the topic sentence.
